description: Guess a hidden number from 1–100; give higher/lower hints, count valid attempts, and end on a correct guess.

requirements.text: Give a higher/lower hint after incorrect guesses.
requirements.check: Give a higher/lower hint after incorrect guesses.

requirements.text: Increment attempts once per valid guess.
requirements.check: Increment attempts once per valid guess.

requirements.text: End the round with a success message after the correct guess.
requirements.check: End the round with a success message after the correct guess.
